project: Attacker Container Isolation and Access Control (Kubernetes Orchestration Layer)

tests.name: Kubernetes cluster connectivity and RBAC identity
tests.expected: Connected to cluster with valid namespace permissions
tests.details: Least-privilege RBAC active: cluster node access correctly forbidden; namespace-scoped operations active

tests.name: Namespace and workload deployment
tests.expected: Pod attacker-demo-session deployed and Running in attacker-lab

tests.name: Attacker runs as non-root user
tests.actual: Spec: runAsUser=1001, runAsNonRoot=true; Live: uid=1001(student) gid=1001(student) groups=1001(student)

tests.name: Read-only root filesystem
tests.expected: readOnlyRootFilesystem: true and write attempts rejected
tests.actual: Spec: readOnlyRootFilesystem=true; Output: touch: cannot touch '/test': Read-only file system
tests.details: Filesystem write operations to rootfs are blocked

tests.name: No privilege escalation permitted
tests.expected: allowPrivilegeEscalation: false (strictly false) and kernel NoNewPrivs: 1
tests.details: Processes cannot acquire new privileges through setuid/setgid

tests.name: Linux capabilities restricted as intended
tests.expected: Drop ALL capabilities, no dangerous administrative capabilities permitted
tests.details: All Linux capabilities dropped (NET_RAW removed to strictly satisfy Pod Security Standards Baseline)

tests.name: Seccomp security profile attached and enforced
tests.expected: seccompProfile configured with RuntimeDefault; Kernel reports Seccomp: 2 (filtering mode)
tests.details: Kubernetes RuntimeDefault profile enforced at kernel syscall boundary (distinct from custom Docker JSON profile)

tests.name: Assigned attacker can reach target
tests.expected: HTTP 200 Welcome to nginx from assigned session target
tests.details: Target endpoint: http://target-demo-session (establishes networking positive control)

tests.name: Cross-session target access blocked
tests.expected: Traffic to other-session target blocked by NetworkPolicy while probe workload is Ready
tests.actual: Traffic to 10.244.0.41 rejected/timed out (exit code 28) by NetworkPolicy while probe was confirmed Ready
tests.details: Multi-tenant session isolation verified with positive controls

tests.name: Unapproved external egress blocked
tests.expected: External internet egress blocked (1.1.1.1:80 unreachable by NetworkPolicy)
tests.actual: External egress to 1.1.1.1 blocked by NetworkPolicy (exit code 28)
tests.details: Data exfiltration prevention policy active; verified tool availability

tests.name: Runtime package management blocked
tests.expected: apt-get update blocked with non-zero exit code
tests.details: Package installation prevented by read-only rootfs

tests.name: Command gateway blocks prohibited commands
tests.expected: Shared validator blocks APT, PIP, Git clone, shell operators, and invalid session IDs
tests.actual: Apt: true, Pip: true, Chaining: true, AllowedId: true, SessionValid: true
tests.details: Shared security validator module verified without regex duplication

tests.name: Audit logging records operations and security events
tests.expected: New valid JSONL audit and security events verified for test action
tests.actual: Audit eventId: e06fff9c..., Security eventId: bb6fb4e1... (both verified valid JSONL)
tests.details: Verified structured JSONL format, timestamps, and unique UUID eventIds

tests.name: Session cleanup removes only session-owned resources
tests.expected: Targeted session deleted cleanly while other sessions remain unaffected
tests.actual: Ephemeral session cleanly provisioned and deleted; verified ownership labels and preserved unrelated pods
tests.details: Resource ownership boundaries respected during teardown

tests.name: Dashboard reflects Kubernetes workload status
tests.expected: Active sessions and container lists accurately reported for Kubernetes
